_doc: Fixtures: things that stand in or on a tile without changing what the tile is (src/decor.py; Dungeon Alive 2026-11-12). The picture is assets/tiles/env/fixtures/<id>.png, drawn over the tile; without one, a blocking fixture is drawn as a plain block in 'color' and a decal is not drawn. 'layer': floor (a flat decal on a walkable tile), stand (an object on a floor tile), wall (hung on or cut into a wall tile). 'blocks': nothing can walk through it. 'opaque': it blocks sight like a pillar. 'look': what Observe (O) says. 'name': what a bump says stands in the way. 'spent_look': what Observe says once a lore fixture is spent, when it differs. 'flat': a mark lying flat on the floor (a scorch, a crack, ash, snow, leaves): it may lie anywhere, out in a room or in a corridor. Every other loose floor piece is an object, and objects lie against a wall, in a small group (src/decor.py _place_cluster; Brandon's play-test 2026-11-12: "big empty rooms with random stuff on the floor").

labrys_mark.name: a double-axe carving
labrys_mark.look: A double axe is cut into the stone and filled with old red paint. The Minoans of Crete carved this sign again and again, and some scholars think that it gave the labyrinth its name.

bull_fresco.name: a bull fresco
bull_fresco.look: A faded painting shows a red bull and a youth leaping over its horns, for the Minoans painted bull-leapers upon their palace walls.

horns_consecration.name: stone horns
horns_consecration.look: Two stone horns stand on a base, the horns of consecration that the Minoans set up where something sacred once stood.

bone_pile.name: old bones
bone_pile.look: Here lie old bones of folk who came thus far and no farther.

rubble.name: rubble
rubble.look: Stones have fallen from the ceiling, though not lately, you hope.

wall_torch.name: a torch
wall_torch.look: A torch burns in an iron sconce still, for someone keeps these lit.

cobweb.name: a cobweb
cobweb.look: A curtain of old web hangs here, spun by something very large or very patient.

broken_pot.name: a broken jar
broken_pot.look: A storage jar lies smashed, and by the husks it held grain.

statue_shield.name: a statue
statue_shield.look: A stone warrior holds his shield before his face. He saw it coming, but the shield did not save him.

statue_stride.name: a statue
statue_stride.look: A man in stone is caught in mid-stride, looking back over his shoulder.

statue_kneel.name: a statue
statue_kneel.look: A man of stone kneels, having thrown an arm across his eyes too late.

statue_reach.name: a statue
statue_reach.look: A woman in stone reaches out one hand, her mouth open on a word that nobody heard.

statue_spear.name: a statue
statue_spear.look: A spearman stands in stone, and moss has grown up over his greaves.

column_drum.name: a fallen column
column_drum.look: Here lies the drum of a fluted marble column, fallen from beneath a roof that is long gone.

ivy.name: ivy
ivy.look: Thick dark ivy grows where no sun has ever reached.

roots.name: roots
roots.look: Pale roots of something that grows far above push up between the slabs.

snake_skin.name: a snake skin
snake_skin.look: Here lies a shed snake skin, longer than you are tall.

olive_leaves.name: olive leaves
olive_leaves.look: Dry olive leaves have blown in from nowhere, and the olive was Athena's tree.

offering_basin.name: an offering basin
offering_basin.look: A marble basin for offerings stands here, long dry.

statue_rubble.name: broken statues
statue_rubble.look: Here are a stone hand and a stone head, broken from what was once a person.

stalagmite.name: a stalagmite
stalagmite.look: A stalagmite rises here, black with old soot.

slayer_bones.name: a burned skeleton
slayer_bones.look: A skeleton lies burned where it fell, with a split shield and a snapped sword.

scorch_mark.name: a scorch mark
scorch_mark.look: The stone is scorched black in a great splash, for something breathed fire here.

ember_crack.name: a glowing crack
ember_crack.look: A crack in the rock glows with heat from somewhere far below.

ash_drift.name: ash
ash_drift.look: Grey ash has drifted against the stone like snow.

crystal_cluster.name: red crystals
crystal_cluster.look: Dull red crystals grow out of the rock, and they are warm to the touch.

pick_and_cart.name: a mining cart
pick_and_cart.look: A pick leans on a mining cart of dwarf make, left by one who dug here and departed in haste.

frozen_warrior.name: a frozen warrior
frozen_warrior.look: A warrior stands frozen in a pillar of ice, his axe still raised.

rune_stone.name: a runestone
rune_stone.look: This is a runestone, and its runes run along a carved serpent's body, as on the old stones of the north.

snow_drift.name: snow
snow_drift.look: Snow has drifted in here from nowhere.

icicles.name: icicles
icicles.look: The icicles are as long as spears.

mead_bench.name: a bench
mead_bench.look: A drinking horn is frozen fast to the wood of a long mead-hall bench.

shield_wall.name: shields
shield_wall.look: Round shields hang along the wall, as in a hall of the north.

broken_fetter.name: a broken fetter
broken_fetter.look: A shackle as wide as a cartwheel lies here, with a few links of broken chain.

frozen_bones.name: frozen bones
frozen_bones.look: Bones lie half buried in the frost.

brazier_cold.name: a brazier
brazier_cold.look: An iron brazier is full of dead coals. If it were lit, it would melt the ice round it.

brazier_lit.name: a brazier
brazier_lit.look: An iron brazier is burning here.

smoke_vent.name: a smoking crack
smoke_vent.look: Smoke rises from a crack in the glass. On the floor of the Pit, the locusts climb out of such cracks as these.
smoke_vent.spent_look: Smoke still rises from the crack, for the words you spoke over it were not enough.

hanging_chains.name: chains
hanging_chains.look: Chains hang down the wall with hooks upon their ends.

bone_spire.name: a bone spire
bone_spire.look: Black bones rise in a spire, fused together by the heat.

brimstone.name: brimstone
brimstone.look: Yellow sulphur bubbles here, hot enough to burn straight through your boots.

glow_fissure.name: a glowing fissure
glow_fissure.look: A wide crack glows deep red.

seal_stone.name: a seal stone
seal_stone.look: A black standing stone bears the stamp of a red seal.

ruined_throne.name: a broken throne
ruined_throne.look: A throne of black stone is split down the back.

fallen_star.name: a fallen star
fallen_star.look: A star fell here, and its black and silver rock is still white-hot within the cracks.

bronze_grate.name: a bronze grate
bronze_grate.look: The bars of this bronze grate are as thick as a man's wrist.

bronze_grate_open.name: a raised grate
bronze_grate_open.look: The bronze grate has been raised.

statue_crowd.name: a crowd of statues
statue_crowd.look: Statues stand packed shoulder to shoulder, and every one of them looks back.

fire_curtain.name: a curtain of fire
fire_curtain.look: A sheet of fire burns here upon nothing at all.

fire_out.name: dead embers
fire_out.look: A line of embers is dying where the fire stood.

snow_barrier.name: a wall of snow
snow_barrier.look: The snow is packed hard and colder than snow should be, and it does not melt.

snow_slush.name: slush
snow_slush.look: Grey slush is all that is left of the drift.

wax_seal.name: a great seal
wax_seal.look: A seal of red wax as wide as a door bears the stamp of a horned sign.

wax_seal_broken.name: a broken seal
wax_seal_broken.look: The great seal lies broken in three.

bunk.name: a bunk
bunk.look: A grey blanket lies on a rough bunk.

weapon_rack.name: a weapon rack
weapon_rack.look: A rack holds old spears and a sword, rusted fast to the wood.

cook_pot.name: a cook-pot
cook_pot.look: A cold cook-pot hangs over dead ashes.

bookshelf.name: a bookshelf
bookshelf.look: The shelves are crammed with scroll-cases and old books.

reading_desk.name: a lectern
reading_desk.look: A great book lies open upon a lectern.

strongbox_empty.name: an empty strongbox
strongbox_empty.look: A strongbox has been broken open and emptied.

ledger_desk.name: a clerk's desk
ledger_desk.look: A clerk's desk holds a ledger, an inkpot and a little set of coin scales.

candles.name: candles
candles.look: Somebody lit these candles, and they are burning still.

icon.name: an icon
icon.look: A painted icon in gold and red shows a robed figure with a halo.

straw.name: straw
straw.look: The straw is trampled and smells of the things that sleep on it.

cage.name: a cage
cage.look: An iron cage stands with its door hanging open.

feed_trough.name: a trough
feed_trough.look: There is a little old grain in the feed trough.

honeycomb.name: honeycomb
honeycomb.look: The wax comb is heavy with honey.

honey_drip.name: honey
honey_drip.look: Honey lies here in a puddle.

grave_marker.name: a grave marker
grave_marker.look: A grave marker leans here, its name worn away.

lily_pads.name: lily pads
lily_pads.look: Lily pads float on still water.

carpet.name: a carpet
carpet.look: A worn runner of red carpet lies here.

banner.name: a banner
banner.look: A red banner bears a crown of faded gold.

copyist_desk.name: a copyist's desk
copyist_desk.look: A half-copied page lies on a scribe's desk.

alchemist_bench.name: an alchemist's bench
alchemist_bench.look: An alchemist's bench holds a glass retort, flasks and a burner gone cold.

surveyor_table.name: a surveyor's table
surveyor_table.look: A half-drawn map is pinned flat upon a table.

memorial_stone.name: a memorial stone
memorial_stone.look: Rows of names are cut into this stone.

wayside_icon.name: a wayside shrine
wayside_icon.look: A little roofed shrine on a post holds a painted icon and a candle.

trophy_board.name: a trophy board
trophy_board.look: A hunter's board bears antlers, tusks and a small skull.

brazen_head.name: a brazen head
brazen_head.look: A bronze head with eyes of glass rests on a stone plinth.

riddle_lintel.name: a carved lintel
riddle_lintel.look: An owl and a line of writing are carved upon the lintel.

gamblers_table.name: a gaming table
gamblers_table.look: Cards, dice and a little heap of copper lie on a rough table.

field_kitchen.name: a cooking fire
field_kitchen.look: A pot on a tripod hangs over a camp fire, with a ladle and a sack of vegetables.

fire_vent.name: a vent
fire_vent.look: An iron-ringed vent in the floor glows deep inside. It breathes fire on a beat and glows white the turn before, so watch it once and you will know when to cross.

fire_vent_active.name: a jet of fire
fire_vent_active.look: Fire roars up out of the vent, so wait for it to die down.

thin_ice.name: thin ice
thin_ice.look: Thin, cracked ice lies over black water. It might hold you, but it would not hold you and a heavy pack.

crumbling_floor.name: cracked flagstones
crumbling_floor.look: The flagstones are cracked and sagging, with darkness in the gaps, and they will not take much weight.

strangler_vine.name: thorny vines
strangler_vine.look: Thick thorny vines lie across the floor, and some of them are moving. Whatever walks through them is held fast.

soul_sigil.name: a burned sigil
soul_sigil.look: A ring of sigils is burned into the glass, and it drinks the magic of whoever stands on it.

icicle_shadow.name: broken ice
icicle_shadow.look: Shards of broken ice lie below a ceiling that bristles with icicles, for something fell here and more are hanging.

bedroll.name: a bedroll
bedroll.look: A bedroll and a pack lie here.

campfire.name: a campfire
campfire.look: A campfire still burns in a ring of stones.

banner_goblin.name: a goblin banner
banner_goblin.look: A ragged hide painted with a red hand hangs on a pole, with bones dangling from it.

banner_bandit.name: a bandit standard
banner_bandit.look: A torn black cloth with a white skull flies upon a spear.

banner_cult.name: a cult standard
banner_cult.look: A black cloth with a red horned sign hangs on a pole topped by a skull.

banner_giant.name: a giant's standard
banner_giant.look: A whole tree serves for a pole, with a bear pelt and antlers lashed to it.

banner_fae.name: a fair-folk pennant
banner_fae.look: Silk of silver-green flies from a slender white pole that is twined with thorns.

banner_dead.name: a necromancer's standard
banner_dead.look: A rotted grey cloth with a black hand hangs from a pole of bone.

sk_idol.name: a Stray Kids shrine
sk_idol.look: A gaudy gold idol of a pop star stands frozen mid-dance, with glitter on everything and eight little gold dancers circling its feet. Lightsticks stand round it like candles, and SKZ and STAY are scratched into the gold, over and over, inside hearts. A bass beat thumps inside it, and you are sure that it wants to be touched.
sk_idol.spent_look: The gold statue of a pop idol has grown dull and lost its glitter, for the encore is over.

sk_speaker.name: a speaker stack
sk_speaker.look: Two big black concert speakers stand one upon the other, and the bass that comes out of them goes straight through your ribs.

race_tether_post.name: a tether post
race_tether_post.look: A stout wooden post is driven into the cavern floor, its top worn smooth by ropes, and from an iron ring hang short tethers, frayed where birds have fought them.

race_betting_board.name: a betting board
race_betting_board.look: A chalk board on an easel gives the day's odds in a loud, crooked hand. Brassbeak is at the top with the shortest odds, underlined three times.

race_finish_banner.name: a finish banner
race_finish_banner.look: A long red banner is strung between two poles over the finish line, with FINISH painted on it in big gold letters that are flaking now.

conjured_vine.name: grapevine and ivy
conjured_vine.look: Grapevine and ivy have grown up out of the stone in a moment and are moving still. Whatever walks through them is held, but they will not last.
